$doc: Vyomi capability registry — Azure blades shared by every service (Export template, Activity log, RBAC extras, Resource health, Tags/Locks, Diagnostics). See aws/s3.json for the contract.

azure.common.export_template.title: Export template (ARM, Bicep, Terraform) on every resource
limitations: The ARM template is built from the properties Vyomi stores for the resource (system/read-only properties such as provisioningState are dropped by a fixed list, not each resource provider's real schema), so it may omit or include properties real Azure would treat differently.
Bicep is a deterministic decompilation of that template (symbolic names, parameters, resource declarations); nested child resources are exported flat and no dependsOn is inferred.
Terraform output uses the generic azapi_resource form (Azure/azapi provider), not hand-mapped azurerm_* resources.
